messages:
Alex M: Hey folks — PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/31021. Changes: eviction heuristic tweak, fallback routing + kv_cache.enabled flag. CI is green except one flaky perf matrix on p3-small. Need runtime + platform + security approvals and a merge slot today if possible. cc @SamR @JenL @DrewS
Jen L: Taking a look now. Can you paste the config diff for the fallback policy? Also which canary percentage do you want?
Alex M: Sure — diff:
```diff
- fallback: none
+ fallback:
+   preferred: warm-model
+   cooldown_s: 30
+   kv_cache: enabled
```
Canary plan: 5% for first 2 hours, then 25% if stable.
Sam R: Quick perf note — local latency median up ~8% on 2x1024 seqs on g5. Do you have the binned latency distribution from CI? If it's just the tail we can tolerate it.
Alex M: Perf numbers from CI run: p50 +2%, p95 +6%, p99 +9% (impact concentrated on short sequences). We think it's kv-cache warmup; added a prefix warmup step in the rollout config to mitigate.
Drew S: Security Q — any changes to key handling or KMS scopes with the new kv_cache flag? We need to know if this touches secrets or introduces new env vars.
Alex M: No KMS changes, no new keys. kv_cache is purely in-process/in-memory toggling. No extra env vars. I'll add a short security note in the PR description to be explicit.
Sam R: OK, I can +1 after you add the warmup step and re-run the perf job once. Also include a regression alert in the rollout (so we auto-rollback if p95 increases >10%).
Jen L: +1 pending Sam's perf re-run. If Sam signs off I'll take the merge slot at 15:30 PT.
Drew S: Reviewed the note in the PR, no objections. One request: emit an audit log event when fallback routing triggers (for later investigation). Otherwise +1 from Security.
merge-bot: Merge slot reserved by Jen L for 15:30 PT. Reminder: CI must be green and all merge checks passing at the time of merge.
Alex M: Thanks — addressing the audit-log note and kicking off the perf rerun now. Will ping here when green :thumbsup:
